desc:
🔍 Welcome to Check your Playtime & Stats!

Check your account value, total walk distance, total deaths, total games joined, and your playtime estimation.

🎮 Features:
🕒 Get an estimate of your stats!
🧠 Simple one-click gameplay!
👫 Check how much your friends have played!
✅ 100% game-based, no personal data needed!

⚠️ Donation Notes:
• Roblox Plus required.
• If you're under 18, donations may require parental approval and you may need to rejoin the server.
